title: Evidence ingestion & self-service onramp: customer audit prep runway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a phased customer-facing evidence ingestion and verification path that enables enterprise customers to self-prepare for SOC2/ISO audits. Scope: 1) API + UI for secure evidence upload (S3-backed, tenant-scoped) 2) Verification workflow and checklist that maps artifacts to controls 3) Dashboard for evidence status and remediation tasks 4) Integration points for SSO/SAML and audit log exports. Out of scope for this ticket: long-term retention tier policy changes and legal contract updates.
background: Customers currently rely on ad-hoc engineering support to assemble audit evidence. This creates friction for enterprise onboarding and increases time-to-close for compliance gates. A self-serve evidence onramp will reduce manual support tickets, standardize ingestion, and shorten sales cycles for Dedicated and Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Secure API endpoint available to customers for evidence upload with tenant-scoped isolation
Upload UI in Console allowing users to tag evidence to control IDs and enter metadata
Automated mapping of common artifact types (SSO config, audit logs, KMS proof) to SOC2/ISO control checklist
Evidence status dashboard surfaced to both customer and internal Assurance team
End-to-end test demonstrating a sample customer completes evidence onramp and produces an exportable audit bundle
RBAC gating for evidence delete/modify operations and audit log retention flagged in Console
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: PII or secrets uploaded accidentally. Mitigation: client-side guidance, server-side scanning for secrets, and mandatory retention TTL for initial beta
Risk: Mis-tagged artifacts lead to audit gaps. Mitigation: conservative default mappings + manual verification step by internal Assurance during initial rollouts
Risk: SSO/SAML metadata upload surface opens attack vector. Mitigation: require pre-registration of customer contact and validate cert fingerprints
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff with Assurance, Infra, and Console teams. Agreed scope for phase 1 (upload + tagging + dashboard).
2026-03-05: Design sync — DES feedback: prefer 'suggested control' auto-fill based on artifact filename heuristics; flagged accessibility updates for upload flow.
2026-03-08: Infra spike landed (ENG-40218) for tenant-scoped S3 prefixes and signed URL patterns. Early perf numbers look good.
2026-03-11: Security review scheduled; security requested threat model for SAML metadata path and artifact scanning checklist.
2026-03-14: P0 decision: require two-stage verification for evidence marked as 'compliant' in the dashboard during beta
open_questions: What retention TTL should we set for beta uploads before a customer can request permanent archival?
Should the evidence export bundle include raw logs or a hashed index to limit data exfil risk?
Which existing audit controls map to our internal control IDs — need canonical mapping from Assurance team
